t: This is the Hallfield Estate, one of several modernist housing projects in Bayswater. It was planned just after the war by the Tecton practice, led by Berthold Lubetkin. When Tecton dissolved, Denys Lasdun and Lindsay Drake carried the work through in the 1950s. Building happened in two phases, from 1951 to 1955 and from 1955 to 1958. Lasdun is best known for the Royal National Theatre on the South Bank, a celebrated example of Brutalist design, so you are seeing an earlier chapter of his career.
